How do you talk about travelling at your English maturita?
People travel to relax, to discover new cultures or to visit friends.
Flying is the fastest way, but it is expensive and bad for the planet.
Trains are slower, yet comfortable, and you can enjoy the view.
A car gives you freedom, but traffic jams can ruin your trip.
You can stay in a hotel, a hostel or at a campsite.
Don't forget your passport, some local currency and travel insurance.
At the exam, compare two kinds of transport and give reasons:
I prefer trains, because they are cheaper and greener than planes.
